steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Now, now, everyone. Just a little false alarm! Let's not allow this to cloud the bright future of our wonderful relations, shall we?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Tell the reporters outside that both delegations were exchanging anti-Mania technologies. Have maintenance turn back the clock. I want this place spotless in ten hours. Leave the paperwork and politics to me, and rest easy knowing the Speaker of DisCity got your backs! Now, any objections?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I've already called in people from the Bureau. You lovely young ladies will be going back with them, alright?
He looks at the two girls with an amiable grin on his face, though his voice grows increasingly cold. Elvira instinctively retreats behind Hecate for protection.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Now you remember to hide? Well, lucky for you, it's not too late yet. There are plenty of paparazzi lenses out there for you to hide from. If that face of yours gets seen again, we won't be just talking about silly gossip.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: That Chief will be in big trouble.
Elvira's face drains of color as King fixes her with a cold stare while voicing the warning. Then, he walks away, striding past you without even a glance, his countenance heavy with shadows.
Surprisingly, the Fraser advisor, who was supposedly ambushed, gazes at the scolded Elvira with a look of admiration.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Our Speaker's being too harsh, isn't he? At this age, few would have the courage to come all the way here. Her concerns were valid, and in fact, the depth of her consideration speaks to remarkable wisdom.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Are you Speaker Stewart's daughter? Your father raised you well.
Elvira frowns, showing no appreciation for the compliment. She remains hidden behind Hecate, and you notice her quietly clenching her fists.
Adelaide seems unfazed. He gestures to his Fraser companions nearby as if to say, "I'll be right there." Then, he turns to you.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I wish for peace between city-states, just as I earnestly hope siblings might always treat one another with mutual respect and love.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: DisCity was once the youngest, carefully nurtured by its elders. Now, like Fraser, you've matured into the strongest of human city-states... and with that strength comes an elder sibling's duty to guide those who follow.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: DisCity holds this era's one and only survival resource. Do not exploit it for greed, wield it to enslave the weak, nor humiliate those already in anguish. The Hypercube should exist to preserve life. Never let it become a source of sins.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: And please, halt this descent. Tend to the Promised Land beneath you with care. Even the faintest Black Ring born here may send catastrophic ripples afar, claiming lives tenfold elsewhere.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Chief, I know you have personally faced the Outland spy who wields Aurum Secretum to summon corruptive rain. This is why I trust you to grasp my meaning, why I believe you're unlike the rest...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Much like lovely little Hella, who always has your name on her lips.
[CG: Waiting for Handshake]
He stands up and extends his hand to you.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Of course, I believe in your ability to inspire change. You once changed Syndicate and brought hope to half the city. Why shouldn't the world be next?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I hope this Great Expo can be the catalyst we need. Let it begin with you and me—mutual understanding, mutual trust—and from there, we address humanity's true challenges together.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: You have my sincerest appreciation.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Take your time. We still have plenty before this is over.
You ask Schorl to step aside.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Understood. As agreed, I interact only with you alone, Chief. Shutting down now.
Now, only the three of you remain.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I was overthinking and ended up scaring Hecate. I didn't know you had such a strong guard and was being reckless...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...No, you've always been cautious. It's my fault. I keep imagining things that aren't real. I'm sorry...
The two girls bow their heads, voices hushed, looking like children confessing to having broken a vase.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Actually, you two helped me big there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To be honest, I was at my wit's end in there. Thank you for saving me.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Really?
You nod like a bobblehead doll.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just promise me you'll be more careful next time, okay? Or at least give me a heads-up first.
Only then does she smile.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I understand. I trust you, Chief.
But the other girl still looks worried. An FAC troop has arrived at the entrance, ready to escort them back. Before saying goodbye, you think for a moment and quietly call her over.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: About that Adelaide guy, he's really strong, but has one weakness. You absolutely must remember...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...What is it?
You lean in with a serious expression, speaking in a hushed voice. Catching your tension, Elvira nervously grips the hem of her dress and brings her ear closer to hear what you have to say...

steps.speaker: Option
options: That guy has a creepy sister complex.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Huh?
You deliberately feign a serious expression.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I heard it with my own ears... It's terrifying. All girls should stay away from him, and I need you to do the same, okay? I really need you on the team, and I promise to share intelligence with you and always hear you out.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Pfft. Okay, got it.
She finally relaxes, her face brightening with a smile more fitting for someone her age.
